gloss_en: Can BonsaiBIM draw a gravel hatch pattern, which is common in Indonesia?
question_paraphrase: asks whether BonsaiBIM can produce a gravel pattern in drawings because gravel is very common in Indonesian projects
phrasing_notes: very short question, no version info, local-need justification
answer_summary: Bonsai outputs SVG/DXF so tileable SVG patterns and CSS class-based fills can be applied; works in SVG fill mode but not with the Shapely cut/projection path.

gloss_en: Student applying to GSoC asks how to add BCF API connectivity to the IfcOpenShell BCF libraries.
title_original: Adding the ability to the BCF Libraries to connect with the API
question_paraphrase: second-year undergrad with Python and Django experience wants to add BCF API support to the BCF libraries and has been reading BCF 2.1 and 3.0 docs
phrasing_notes: formal student proposal register, states own background first
answer_summary: Maintainer advised separate submodules per BCF version, no cross-version translators, diffing the XSD schemas, and targeting BCFXML 2.1/3.0 plus BCF API 3.0.

gloss_en: GSoC'24 project announcement: web app to create and check IDS exchange requirements with IfcTester.

phrasing_notes: project-plan register, lists tasks; no user question
answer_summary: No replies captured; scope is IDS CRUD, facet editor, drag-and-drop import and IFC audit against IDS.

gloss_en: Count proxies in the model and show which Revit categories they came from
prompt: how many IfcBuildingElementProxy are there in this model? group by category pls, client is asking why everything is proxy
expected_behavior: Count IfcBuildingElementProxy, group by Revit category/ObjectType property, report counts, suggest export class mapping fixes.

gloss_en: Give concrete volume per storey for the tender BOQ
prompt: need total concrete volume (slabs, beams, columns) storey wise for BOQ, tender submission tomorrow. use NetVolume if available otherwise GrossVolume
expected_behavior: Query IfcSlab/IfcBeam/IfcColumn grouped by storey, read Qto NetVolume with GrossVolume fallback, flag missing quantities, output a table.

gloss_en: Check the model against an e-submission checklist: every space has name, area and a storey
prompt: check this model for e-submission: all IfcSpace should have name, area and be inside a storey. list the ones that fail
expected_behavior: Iterate IfcSpace, check Name, area quantity and containment in IfcBuildingStorey, report failures with GlobalId.

gloss_en: Add a classification reference to all doors from a type name mapping
prompt: add classification code to all doors based on type name, i will give mapping excel. dont touch other elements
expected_behavior: Ask for or read mapping, add IfcClassificationReference to matching IfcDoor types, leave other elements unchanged, report count.

gloss_en: List elements on level 5 for tomorrow's pour
prompt: list all columns and walls on level 5 with their ids, site team need for pour sequence
expected_behavior: Find IfcBuildingStorey named level 5, list contained IfcColumn and IfcWall with GlobalId and Name.

gloss_en: Compare two model revisions and list added, deleted and moved elements
prompt: compare rev A and rev B ifc, what elements added deleted or moved? only structural
expected_behavior: Diff by GlobalId for structural classes, report added/removed and placement/geometry changes.

gloss_en: Export an asset list of MEP equipment with manufacturer and serial
prompt: Please give me an asset register of all mechanical equipment with manufacturer, model and serial number columns. blanks also show
expected_behavior: Collect IfcFlowTerminal/IfcDistributionElement equipment, read Pset_ManufacturerTypeInformation/serial properties, output table incl. empties.

gloss_en: Areas look wrong, maybe feet vs metres
prompt: room areas in this ifc look too big like 10x. is it unit issue? check project units
expected_behavior: Read IfcProject units, inspect length/area unit conversion, compare space area values and explain scale error.

gloss_en: Check every structural member has a material, such as M25 concrete or Fe500 rebar
prompt: which beams/columns have no material assigned? also list the grades used (M25, M30 etc)
expected_behavior: Check IfcRelAssociatesMaterial on beams/columns, list unassigned, list distinct material names.

gloss_en: IFC export is huge and slow, how to reduce
prompt: ifc export from revit 2023 is 900MB and takes forever, how to reduce size? model is just 2 towers
expected_behavior: Suggest tessellation/detail level, exclude unneeded categories and linked files, disable 2D elements, split by discipline; in a loaded file offer to count duplicated geometry.

gloss_en: Model lands far from origin, check georeferencing
prompt: my model opens very far from origin in viewer. check map conversion / eastings northings and site placement
expected_behavior: Read IfcMapConversion/IfcProjectedCRS and IfcSite placement, report offsets, advise shifting origin.

gloss_en: Which IFC version should I use for submission?
prompt: which ifc version should i export for submission, 2x3 or ifc4? what is CV2.0 and reference view
expected_behavior: Explain IFC2x3 vs IFC4, coordination view vs reference view MVDs, advise following the project EIR.

gloss_en: List duct systems and total duct length per system
prompt: show all mep systems, ducts total length for each system. hvac only
expected_behavior: List IfcSystem/IfcDistributionSystem for HVAC, sum IfcDuctSegment length per system.

gloss_en: Create an IDS requiring fire rating on walls and test the model
prompt: make IDS: all walls must have FireRating in Pset_WallCommon. run on model, tell me which fail
expected_behavior: Build IDS spec for IfcWall requiring Pset_WallCommon.FireRating, run validation, list failing elements.

gloss_en: Add a local hatch pattern to section drawings
prompt: how to add my own hatch (like laterite stone) to material in section drawing?
expected_behavior: Explain assigning a custom SVG pattern/CSS class to the material representation in drawing styles.

gloss_en: Total gross floor area by storey for a summary
prompt: give gross floor area per floor and total, in sqm. one line each
expected_behavior: Sum IfcSpace or slab gross areas per storey, convert to sqm, return concise per-floor lines and total.
